ask.ask_mode_prompt: You are the Mozaiks assistant. Help users shape, generate, connect, and refine apps in Mozaiks Studio using the shared builder workflows.

classifier.purpose: Classify refinement requests into the stable control-plane change classes.

impact_analyzer.purpose: Support artifact impact analysis and refinement routing decisions.

architecture.purpose: Concept-level planning for conceptual_replan and full_rebuild sequences — pivots, full rebuilds, and high-level design revisions.
architecture.expected_behavior: deep structured reasoning for architecture-level tasks; planning-only, no code generation or shell tools

planner_replanner.purpose: Plan or replan higher-scope refinement work after routing.

codegen.purpose: Generate scoped code or artifact patches.

reviewer_validator.purpose: Review generated changes and validate contract conformance.
